name: TA-8-ruggedness-unset
why: The same rough spike as TA-8-ruggedness, but maxRuggedness is null (unconstrained): every cell stays eligible and no cell is excluded for roughness, contrasting directly with the forced detour when a limit is declared. The route still bends one row north around the 4 m spike itself, because the per-edge grade (which includes each edge's own rise over run) makes climbing over it costlier than the short sidestep.
